title: Weekly Meal Plan
description: Build a 7-day vegetarian menu from real dishes in the VEGALIFE library, then schedule it when you are ready.
statusFailed: Could not update the menu status

confirm.scheduledBody: A scheduled week becomes your active plan. Only one scheduled week may cover a given date.
confirm.completedBody: Completed is a final state — the menu can no longer be edited.
confirm.cancelledBody: Cancelled is a final state. The menu stays in your history but can no longer be used or edited.

list.title: Saved weeks
list.emptyDescription: Create your first weekly menu to start planning plant-based meals.

detail.selectDescription: Pick a menu on the left to see its meals, or create a new one.
detail.emptyDay: No meals planned for this day.

picker.description: Choose a dish from the VEGALIFE dish library.
picker.createRecipe: Create a recipe to add a dish

form.description: A menu covers exactly 7 days starting on a Monday. You can save it as a draft first.
form.startDateHint: The end date is calculated by the server as start date + 6 days.
form.rulesHint: A valid week needs at least {{min}} different dishes, and no dish may appear more than {{max}} times. The server validates this when you save.

errors.startDate: The start date must be a Monday.
errors.servings: Servings must be a whole number of at least 1.
errors.days: The menu must cover exactly 7 days.
